records.description: Explore premium Mahindra Thar and Thar Roxx front grills designed for aggressive styling and off-road appeal. Shop Wrangler Style, Predator, Angry Bird, Rubicon-inspired, and LED grills made with durable ABS material for perfect fitment, premium finish, and enhanced road presence. Upgrade your Thar with high-quality aftermarket grills built for modern SUV enthusiasts.

records.name: Sigma AI
records.tagline: OWN your B2B AI agent in less than 5 minutes
records.description: From intelligent workflow orchestration to scalable AI-powered automation, Sigma AI simplifies how modern businesses build, deploy, and operate AI agents — faster, smarter, and with less complexity. 🚀 Streamline operations ⚡ Automate intelligently 📈 Scale with confidence Sigma AI by Arc Link — Built for the future of B2B automation.

records.name: CosmosDev
records.tagline: Fast, free developer utilities without clutter
records.description: CosmosDev is a growing collection of free developer tools built for speed, simplicity, and productivity. It includes utilities like JSON Formatter, JWT Decoder, Base64 Encoder/Decoder, QR Generator, UUID Generator, Password Generator, and more. Built as a solo developer project with a focus on clean UI, fast performance, and an easy developer experience.

records.name: Orchestra Ads
records.tagline: Your marketing, run as a system
records.description: Strategy, ads, content, email, and SEO from one brief. Orchestra connects every channel into one system instead of five disconnected tools. Plans from €29/mo.

records.name: Construction Exhaust
records.tagline: Know who’s building before they call anyone else.
records.description: Most construction leads are "dead on arrival"—they’ve already been scooped up by the big guys or the relationships are already locked in. ConstructionExhaust.com changes the game by using AI-driven OSINT to find the projects nobody else is looking at yet.

records.name: Maps Downloader
records.tagline: Google Maps Image & Video Downloader
records.description: Unlike many tools that require extensions, software installs, or subscriptions, this tool works instantly online with no login or setup. It focuses on speed, simplicity, and preserving original media quality.

records.name: Networth.Online
records.tagline: Upload a bank statement. Get your full financial picture.
records.description: Most finance apps want your banking username and password. We don't — and we never will. Drop a PDF bank statement and get your net worth, spending breakdown, savings rate, subscription audit, and AI insights in under 60 seconds. Free to start.

records.name: Bram - Workout Notes
records.tagline: like notes, but for lifting.
records.description: Bram is the simplest workout tracker ever: as easy as Notes, with progress insights like a personal trainer.

records.name: Wortal CRM
records.tagline: Wortal CRM in India
records.description: Wortal is a powerful CRM Software India companies use to streamline customer management, sales tracking, inventory, and accounting. Our Business Automation Software simplifies daily operations, increases efficiency, and helps businesses manage everything from one smart cloud platform.

records.name: QR & BarCode Generator AI
records.tagline: QR & BarCode Generator with custom images and autocorrection
records.description: CUSTOM BARCODE SHAPES Draw freehand shapes and the barcode lines fill your strokes. A safety bar at the bottom guarantees every code stays scannable. SMART AUTO-OPTIMIZE Colors, opacity, and image size are automatically adjusted to maintain contrast for reliable scanning. An on-screen banner tells you when settings have been tuned. WORKS EVERYWHERE One app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Your purchase unlocks all platforms.

records.name: Shri Ram Rice Unit
records.tagline: Pesticide Free Basmati Rice Exporter India | Shri Ram Rice
records.description: Shri Ram Rice Unit is a leading Pesticide Free Basmati Rice Exporter India, delivering premium quality rice grown without harmful chemicals. Our basmati rice features long grains, rich aroma, and superior taste, processed with advanced techniques and strict quality control. We follow sustainable farming practices and international standards to ensure residue-free, healthy rice for global consumers and importers seeking purity, safety, and consistent excellence.

records.name: Trusio
records.tagline: Live identity verification for marketplace sellers
records.description: Trusio is your portable trust passport. Verify once — government ID, device, and live location — and carry that checkmark to every platform that integrates Trusio. No repeated KYC. No new accounts. One verification, recognized everywhere. How it works: → Complete a one-time verification (under 2 minutes) → Get your trust passport — ID, device, and location certified → Share your Trusio profile on any platform → Platforms and people instantly see what's been verified

records.name: ABC Dragons
records.tagline: Learn and write the alphabet letters!
records.description: ABC Dragons transforms learning letters and early reading into a magical adventure filled with exploration, discovery, and fun. Children travel alongside a friendly dragon through colorful worlds, completing interactive mini-games, collecting magical letter eggs, and developing essential reading skills in a natural and motivating way. The game combines: • Letter recognition • Early phonics awareness • Reading readiness • A positive and accessible experience for young learners

records.name: Taskroup
records.tagline: Organize Projects with Taskroup
records.description: Taskroup is a smart project management and collaboration tool for enterprise, freelancers, teams, and organizations and it keeps you productive, connected, and efficient all in one place.

records.name: Ciente
records.tagline: A Ciente separa análise, explicação por IA e decisão.
records.description: Bancos, corretoras e assessores mostram produtos, taxas e saldos. Isso nem sempre ajuda a entender o que aconteceu com a carteira, comparar uma nova opção ou saber se a recomendação tem incentivo por trás. A Ciente separa análise, explicação por IA e decisão.

records.name: Stoic and philosop. explanation in lol
records.tagline: Stoic and philosophical explanation in leauge of legends
records.description: I aim to offer a different channel experience here. My goal is to incorporate philosophical narratives into games that are often looked down upon, and to make people appreciate philosophy by leveraging the visual appeal of the game.

records.name: WorldX
records.tagline: Type one sentence. Get a living AI world in 5 minutes.
records.description: WorldX generates a complete AI world from one sentence — maps, character sprites, backstories, all original art, not templates. Hit play and AI agents live autonomously: decisions, conversations, memories, reflections, emotions. No scripts — stories emerge naturally. Core trick: a "paint-then-diff" method that lets image models locate objects in their own art precisely, without vision models. TypeScript, Phaser 3, React, SQLite. MIT. Any OpenAI-compatible API.

records.name: BayesCore
records.tagline: Bayesian evidence scoring for any structured claim
records.description: Drop any document with a claim. Bayescore extracts its IS(subject, criterion) hypothesis, derives falsifiable predicates, and scores each using a two-pass adversarial LLM evaluation. Absence of evidence reduces confidence toward zero. Formula locked: score = Σ(weight × confidence) × 100. We ran it on ourselves. 46/100, Grade D. Five failing predicates. Published because it's right, not flattering. bayescore.com/self-eval

records.name: estaie
records.tagline: The 1st global flexible stay platform, focused in 15+ nights
records.description: estaie lets travellers book furnished hotel rooms, serviced apartments, and managed holiday homes for stays ranging from weeks to a year with a single payment flow.
